main_text.l: Presbyteri; nam inquit, Hieronymus dicit quidem

l.i: Episcopum ex Presbyteris electum, à Presbyteris non dicit; potuit autem ex Pres-
byteris ab aliis eligi, vel à populo, vel ab

main_text.l: Episcopis aliis: Quid est argutari, si hoc
non est? tamen reprehendere non veretur
Romani unum ex se electum in excelsiori
gradu seu in Altari collocatum, Papam
nominant; & Vir doctus de solo Papæ
nomine à Cardinalibus impofito id in-
nem; atqui regeram ego, non ignorabat
narrat peragi solitam, per totum illud

page.notes: No marginal notes. The "s" in "solum" and "Pres-" is plain long s as in the printed text. The word "impofito" is printed with a long s and is copied as "impofito". Two words are italic in the printed text: the Hieronymus passage and "Pres-byteris" within it, which is also copied as printed. No catchword and no signature at the foot. The page has a few ink specks on the right and left edges, which are not text.
